name: Cybersecurity
lead: Risk assessments, penetration testing and hardening that find the gaps before attackers do — explained in plain language, with a clear plan to fix them.
inc: Risk assessment
A clear picture of your exposure across website, cloud, devices and people.

Short, practical sessions so your team can spot phishing and scams.
steps: Scope
We agree on the systems to test, the goals and the timing.

faq: Is my business too small to be a target?
No. Small businesses are often targeted precisely because they have fewer defences. A short assessment shows exactly where you stand.
Will testing disrupt my website?
We agree on scope and timing in advance and test carefully, so your normal operations continue.
What do I get at the end?
A plain-language report with prioritised findings and a remediation plan — plus our help fixing them if you want it.
